name: zgeometry_model_is_fully_inside_clip_polygon_xy
description: zGeometry_Model::IsFullyInsideClipPolygonXY scans model faces against a clip polygon, rejecting null inputs, skipping disjoint faces, and returning false when a face is contained by or intersects the clip polygon.
known_limits: The smoke target covers null inputs, disjoint face acceptance, and contained-face rejection through preclassified Weiler return modes; detailed crossing/intersection behavior is covered through accepted callee functional targets and deferred to the coherent model/clip-patch cluster smoke.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46bb90 validates the null guard, zeroed clip-output local, face loop over model->faceCount, invalid-vertex report/continue path, linear vertex buffer acquisition, +90 X rotation, XY bounds computation, bounds-overlap gate, ClipPointList dispatch with mode 4, switch return modes, clip-output destruction, polygon buffer cleanup, and final true return when no face overlaps the clip polygon.
The native model clip-polygon smoke verifies null input returns 0, a disjoint model face returns 1, and a contained model face returns 0 after the Weiler clip path.
